title: Subscription Product
content: Build subscription purchase option. Selection: "One-time purchase" vs "Subscribe & Save X%" radio options. Frequency dropdown: every 2 weeks, monthly, every 2 months, etc. Savings display: show per-delivery price and monthly savings. Benefits list: free shipping, cancel anytime, easy management. Summary: "Delivered every 4 weeks - $24.99/delivery". Manage link: for existing subscribers, link to subscription management.

variants.simple: Create subscription option for repeat purchase products.
variants.detailed: Build subscription purchase option. Selection: "One-time purchase" vs "Subscribe & Save X%" radio options. Frequency dropdown: every 2 weeks, monthly, every 2 months, etc. Savings display: show per-delivery price and monthly savings. Benefits list: free shipping, cancel anytime, easy management. Summary: "Delivered every 4 weeks - $24.99/delivery". Manage link: for existing subscribers, link to subscription management.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive subscription purchase option for consumable/repeat products. Container: bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-4 border or card format near Add to Cart. Purchase type selection: two prominent radio cards or segmented control. One-time option: "One-time purchase" label, regular price displayed. Subscribe option: "Subscribe & Save" label, percentage off badge ("Save 15%"), discounted price (original crossed out), per-delivery price clearly shown, recommended tag if better value. Subscribe option expanded content (when selected): Frequency selector: "Deliver every:" dropdown with options (Every 2 weeks, Every month, Every 6 weeks, Every 2 months, Every 3 months), default to most popular or recommended. Quantity per delivery: if applicable, selector for units per shipment. Next delivery: calculated date displayed ("First delivery: Jan 15, 2024"). Savings calculator: monthly or yearly savings displayed ("Save $120/year"). Benefits list: checkmarks with benefits (✓ 15% off every order, ✓ Free shipping always, ✓ Cancel or skip anytime, ✓ Easy online management, ✓ Exclusive subscriber perks). How it works: expandable section explaining subscription flow. Price breakdown: Regular price crossed out, your price with discount, savings amount highlighted. Subscribe CTA: "Subscribe - $24.99/delivery" button, different styling from one-time (e.g., gradient or accent color). Trust badges: "No commitment", "Pause anytime", "Free cancellation". For existing subscribers: show current subscription status ("You subscribe to this - Next delivery Jan 15"), "Manage Subscription" link, option to add another subscription at different frequency or add more quantity. Subscription management preview: link to portal where they can pause, skip, change frequency, swap products, cancel. First order bonus: "First box includes free gift" or extra discount on first order. Trial option: "Try 1 month for 50% off" trial period offer. Bundle subscriptions: suggest complementary products to add to subscription. Gift subscription: option to purchase subscription as gift with set duration (3, 6, 12 months). Payment info: note about how recurring billing works. Accessibility: radio groups properly labeled, savings announced clearly, subscription terms accessible.
